accepted.evidence: Platts identifies Hindi/Urdu nazdīk near as Persian in origin, while the installed Hindi attestation supplies an immediate donor node. These regional n-z-d-k/contracted variants are recorded as borrowings through a provisional Hindi/Urdu donor proxy; the precise local transmission route is unresolved. Both Awankari alternatives match the same loan family, not two inherited stems.
